## Overview

Qwen3.5 dropped `@support_torch_compile` in favor of breakable CUDA graphs (`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH`, auto-enabled in `vllm/config/vllm.py`). An isolation experiment (same old code, compile vs breakable cudagraph) showed the removal alone cost **+45 ~ 64% decode-step and +22 ~ 39% prefill latency**. This change recovers the lost inductor fusions with explicit fused kernels, ending **5~11% faster than the torch.compile baseline** on decode and at parity on prefill.

## Claims

- End-to-end serving (`vllm bench serve`, up to 128 concurrent requests): decode ITL **-3.0% ~ -8.8%**, prefill TTFT **-7.0% ~ -8.9%** vs the torch.compile baseline (9B + 35B-A3B).
- Isolated forward latency (`vllm bench latency`): decode step **-4.9% ~ -10.7%**, MTP decode **-17% ~ -38%**, prefill at parity.
- Greedy decoding output is **token-identical** to the torch.compile baseline (TP1 and TP2).

## Validation

Environment: 1x NVIDIA GB200 (SM100, aarch64) per run, bf16, real weights (`Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B` dense, `Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` MoE). Baseline = pre-removal commit (`44e88ae582^`) with default `VLLM_COMPILE`; "old+breakable" = same commit with `VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`; "this PR" = HEAD with all fusions. Note: newer vLLM defaults prefix caching ON, which alone inflated TTFT by ~17-20% in an unnormalized run — both trees below use identical serving flags to avoid that artifact.

### End-to-end serving (vllm serve + vllm bench serve, random dataset)

Both trees with identical serving flags (`--no-enable-prefix-caching --max-num-batched-tokens 8192`; note newer vLLM defaults prefix caching ON, which alone inflated TTFT by ~17-20% in an unnormalized run — flagged here so reviewers don't reproduce that artifact). Load: 320/384/512 prompts (10+ waves) for concurrency 32/64/128 decode, 128 prompts for the 4k-context decode, 16 prompts for single-stream decode and prefill; output 256 tokens (decode) / 8 tokens (prefill), `--ignore-eos`.

| Model | case | metric | baseline (compile) | this PR | Δ | output throughput Δ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9B | decode cc=32 | Mean ITL | 4.84 ms | **4.50 ms** | **-7.0%** | +38.0% |
| 9B | decode cc=64 | Mean ITL | 5.59 ms | **5.25 ms** | **-6.1%** | +7.3% |
| 9B | decode cc=128 | Mean ITL | 7.36 ms | **6.90 ms** | **-6.2%** | +6.2% |
| 9B | decode cc=32, 4k ctx | Mean ITL | 8.89 ms | **8.52 ms** | **-4.2%** | +4.1% |
| 9B | single-stream decode | Mean ITL | 4.16 ms | **3.92 ms** | **-5.8%** | +7.3% |
| 9B | 4k-token prefill | Mean TTFT | 74.50 ms | **67.84 ms** | **-8.9%** | +8.4% |
| 35B-A3B | decode cc=32 | Mean ITL | 8.41 ms | **8.03 ms** | **-4.5%** | +5.7% |
| 35B-A3B | decode cc=64 | Mean ITL | 11.02 ms | **10.58 ms** | **-4.0%** | +4.2% |
| 35B-A3B | decode cc=128 | Mean ITL | 14.09 ms | **13.67 ms** | **-3.0%** | +2.7% |
| 35B-A3B | decode cc=32, 4k ctx | Mean ITL | 12.04 ms | **11.39 ms** | **-5.4%** | +5.4% |
| 35B-A3B | single-stream decode | Mean ITL | 3.52 ms | **3.21 ms** | **-8.8%** | +10.4% |
| 35B-A3B | 4k-token prefill | Mean TTFT | 104.02 ms | **96.74 ms** | **-7.0%** | +8.4% |

The gap narrows at higher concurrency (compute-bound regime, fusion matters less) but never inverts; PR-side numbers were measured on the merged tree (upstream/main `fc47cc8fff`), with post-merge `vllm bench latency` spot checks matching pre-merge within noise (9B decode bs1 3.94 vs 3.93 ms).

### Isolated forward latency (vllm bench latency, decode step = (latency[output=65] - latency[output=1]) / 64)

| Model | bs | baseline (compile) | old+breakable | HEAD (no fixes) | this PR | vs baseline |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9B | 1 | 4.20 ms | 6.07 (+44.5%) | 5.48 (+30.5%) | **3.93 ms** | **-6.6%** |
| 9B | 32 | 4.97 ms | 7.83 (+57.3%) | 6.93 (+39.3%) | **4.50 ms** | **-9.6%** |
| 35B-A3B (MoE) | 1 | 3.39 ms | 5.56 (+64.0%) | 4.98 (+47.1%) | **3.03 ms** | **-10.7%** |
| 35B-A3B (MoE) | 32 | 7.58 ms | 11.17 (+47.5%) | 10.03 (+32.4%) | **7.21 ms** | **-4.9%** |

MTP (`--speculative-config '{"method":"qwen3_5_mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}'`), decode step ms, 9B: bs1 4.91 → **4.07 (-17.2%)**; bs32 8.98 → **5.58 (-37.8%)**.

### Prefill forward (wall seconds, vllm bench latency)

| Model | case | baseline (compile) | old+breakable | HEAD (no fixes) | this PR | vs baseline |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9B | 4096tok x1 | 0.0553 | 0.0734 (+32.7%) | 0.0703 (+27.1%) | **0.0537** | **-2.9%** |
| 9B | 4096tok x8 | 0.3835 | 0.5065 (+32.1%) | 0.4840 (+26.2%) | **0.3802** | **-0.9%** |
| 35B-A3B | 4096tok x1 | 0.0802 | 0.0975 (+21.6%) | 0.0915 (+14.1%) | 0.0829 | +3.4% |
| 35B-A3B | 4096tok x8 | 0.2736 | 0.3802 (+39.0%) | 0.3620 (+32.3%) | **0.2722** | **-0.5%** |

- Kernel unit tests (GB200, via Slurm): **245 passed** (`test_fused_sigmoid_gate_mul.py`, `test_gemma_rms_norm_triton.py`, `test_fused_pre_fc_norms.py`, `test_gdn_qwen35_strided_inputs.py` — the GDN strided/fused-norm paths are asserted bit-exact vs the contiguous/reference kernels).
- End-to-end greedy smoke (9B, 4 prompts x 64 tokens): **token-identical** to the torch.compile baseline at TP1, and TP2 (exercises the fused all-reduce+RMSNorm path) matches TP1 exactly.
- `pytest tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_5_quantization.py`: 4 passed.
- `pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: all hooks pass (ruff, mypy, SPDX, test-tethering).

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B --max-model-len 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --port 8192 &
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8192 --dataset-name random --ignore-eos --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --num-prompts 320 --max-concurrency 32 --random-input-len 128 --random-output-len 256   # decode cc=32 (also: 384@cc64, 512@cc128, 128@cc32 with input 4096)
vllm bench serve ... --num-prompts 16 --max-concurrency 1 --random-input-len 128 --random-output-len 256    # decode single-stream
vllm bench serve ... --num-prompts 16 --max-concurrency 1 --random-input-len 4096 --random-output-len 8    # prefill TTFT

# Isolated forward latency (per tree, per model) — full commands in ~/bench_qwen35_sbatch.sh
vllm bench latency --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B --num-iters-warmup 2 --num-iters 5 --max-model-len 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --input-len 4096 --output-len 1 --batch-size 1     # prefill
vllm bench latency ... --input-len 32 --output-len 1 --batch-size 1     # decode t(1)
vllm bench latency ... --input-len 32 --output-len 65 --batch-size 1    # decode t(65); step = (t65-t1)/64
vllm bench latency ... --input-len 32 --output-len {1,65} --batch-size 32

# MTP decode — ~/mtp_bench_qwen35_sbatch.sh
vllm bench latency --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B --speculative-config '{"method":"qwen3_5_mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}' --input-len 32 --output-len {1,65} --batch-size {1,32} ...

# Kernel unit tests — ~/ktest_qwen35_sbatch.sh
python -m pytest tests/kernels/core/test_fused_sigmoid_gate_mul.py tests/kernels/core/test_gemma_rms_norm_triton.py tests/kernels/core/test_fused_pre_fc_norms.py tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_qwen35_strided_inputs.py -q

# Greedy-output smoke (TP1/TP2) — ~/smoke_qwen35_sbatch.sh + ~/smoke_qwen35.py
python ~/smoke_qwen35.py Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B <tp> out.json   # LLM(..., tensor_parallel_size=tp), temperature=0, 64 tokens x 4 prompts
```

+"""Unit tests for the fused dual-GemmaRMSNorm + concat kernel used by the
+Qwen3.5 MTP drafter.
+
+The kernel must match the eager 3-op reference: two Gemma-style RMSNorms
+(scale by ``1 + weight``, fp32 accumulation) followed by a last-dim concat.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.kernels.triton.fused_pre_fc_norms import fused_pre_fc_norms
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed
+
+EPS = 1e-6
+DTYPES = [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32]
+NUM_TOKENS = [1, 129]
+HIDDEN_SIZES = [2048, 4096]
+# (rtol, atol) per dtype; the kernel accumulates in fp32 like the reference,
+# so the gap is output rounding and reduction order only.
+TOLS = {
+    torch.bfloat16: (1e-2, 1e-3),
+    torch.float16: (1e-3, 1e-4),
+    torch.float32: (1e-5, 1e-5),
+}
+
+requires_cuda = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda(),
+    reason="fused pre-fc norms Triton kernel requires a CUDA device",
+)
+
+
+def _gemma_rmsnorm(x: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor, eps: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    dtype = x.dtype
+    x = x.float()
+    var = x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+    return (x * torch.rsqrt(var + eps) * (w.float() + 1.0)).to(dtype)
+
+
+@requires_cuda
+@torch.inference_mode()
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", NUM_TOKENS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden_size", HIDDEN_SIZES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", DTYPES)
+def test_fused_pre_fc_norms_correctness(
+    num_tokens: int, hidden_size: int, dtype: torch.dtype
+):
+    """Fused kernel == cat([norm_e(embeds), norm_h(hidden)]) for Gemma-style
+    (1 + w) norms with non-zero weights."""
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    embeds = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+    hidden = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+    emb_w = torch.randn(hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device="cuda") * 0.2
+    hid_w = torch.randn(hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device="cuda") * 0.2
+
+    fused = fused_pre_fc_norms(embeds, hidden, emb_w, hid_w, EPS)
+    ref = torch.cat(
+        [_gemma_rmsnorm(embeds, emb_w, EPS), _gemma_rmsnorm(hidden, hid_w, EPS)],
+        dim=-1,
+    )
+
+    assert fused.shape == (num_tokens, 2 * hidden_size)
+    rtol, atol = TOLS[dtype]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(fused.float(), ref.float(), rtol=rtol, atol=atol)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _gemma_rms_norm(x, w, eps, HIDDEN_SIZE: tl.constexpr):
+    x = x.to(tl.float32)
+    mean_sq = tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) / HIDDEN_SIZE
+    rrms = tl.rsqrt(mean_sq + eps)
+    w = w.to(tl.float32) + 1.0
+    return (x * rrms) * w
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fused_pre_fc_norms_kernel(
+    embeds_ptr,
+    embeds_stride,
+    hidden_ptr,
+    hidden_stride,
+    emb_w_ptr,
+    hid_w_ptr,
+    eps,
+    out_ptr,
+    out_stride,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    tok = tl.program_id(0)
+    off = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = off < H
+
+    e = tl.load(embeds_ptr + tok * embeds_stride + off, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    ew = tl.load(emb_w_ptr + off, mask=mask)
+    e_normed = _gemma_rms_norm(e, ew, eps, H)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + tok * out_stride + off, e_normed, mask=mask)
+
+    h = tl.load(hidden_ptr + tok * hidden_stride + off, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    hw = tl.load(hid_w_ptr + off, mask=mask)
+    h_normed = _gemma_rms_norm(h, hw, eps, H)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + tok * out_stride + H + off, h_normed, mask=mask)
+
+
+def fused_pre_fc_norms(
+    inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    emb_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    hid_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Returns cat([norm_e(inputs_embeds), norm_h(hidden_states)]) -> [N, 2H].
+
+    Both norms are Gemma-style RMSNorm (scale by ``1 + weight``, fp32
+    accumulation, multiply in fp32 before the cast back to the input dtype).
+    """
+    n, h = inputs_embeds.shape
+    out = torch.empty(n, 2 * h, dtype=inputs_embeds.dtype, device=inputs_embeds.device)
+    _fused_pre_fc_norms_kernel[(n,)](
+        inputs_embeds,
+        inputs_embeds.stride(0),
+        hidden_states,
+        hidden_states.stride(0),
+        emb_weight,
+        hid_weight,
+        eps,
+        out,
+        out.stride(0),
+        h,
+        triton.next_power_of_2(h),
+    )
+    return out

+"""Fused sigmoid-gate-multiply Triton kernel: ``out = x * sigmoid(gate)``."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fused_sigmoid_gate_mul_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    gate_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    hidden,
+    x_stride_t,
+    gate_stride_t,
+    out_stride_t,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < hidden
+
+    x = tl.load(x_ptr + row * x_stride_t + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    g = tl.load(gate_ptr + row * gate_stride_t + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    out = x.to(tl.float32) * tl.sigmoid(g.to(tl.float32))
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + row * out_stride_t + offs,
+        out.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+
+
+def fused_sigmoid_gate_mul(x: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute ``x * sigmoid(gate)`` in a single Triton kernel.
+
+    Falls back to the eager ``x * torch.sigmoid(gate)`` sequence unless both
+    inputs are same-shape, same-dtype, contiguous 2D CUDA tensors.
+
+    Args:
+        x: (num_tokens, hidden) tensor, e.g. attention output.
+        gate: (num_tokens, hidden) pre-sigmoid gate.
+
+    Returns:
+        A fresh (num_tokens, hidden) tensor with x's dtype and device.
+
+    """
+    if (
+        x.ndim != 2
+        or x.shape != gate.shape
+        or x.dtype != gate.dtype
+        or not x.is_contiguous()
+        or not gate.is_contiguous()
+        or not x.is_cuda
+    ):
+        return x * torch.sigmoid(gate)
+
+    num_tokens, hidden = x.shape
+    out = torch.empty_like(x)
+    if num_tokens == 0 or hidden == 0:
+        return out
+
+    if hidden <= 1024:
+        block = triton.next_power_of_2(hidden)
+        num_warps = 4
+    elif hidden <= 4096:
+        block = 1024
+        num_warps = 4
+    else:
+        block = 2048
+        num_warps = 8
+
+    grid = (num_tokens, triton.cdiv(hidden, block))
+    _fused_sigmoid_gate_mul_kernel[grid](
+        x,
+        gate,
+        out,
+        hidden,
+        x.stride(0),
+        gate.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        BLOCK=block,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    return out

+class Qwen3_5RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Gemma-style RMS normalization backed by flashinfer kernels.
+
+    When ``residual`` is given, the fused add + norm runs in place and the
+    updated ``(x, residual)`` pair is returned.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, eps: float = 1e-6) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
+        set_weight_attrs(self.weight, {"dummy_weight_value": 0.0})
+        self.variance_epsilon = eps
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        from flashinfer.norm import gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm, gemma_rmsnorm
+
+        if residual is None:
+            return gemma_rmsnorm(x, self.weight, self.variance_epsilon)
+
+        # gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm mutates x and residual in place.
+        gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm(x, residual, self.weight, self.variance_epsilon)
+        return x, residual
+

+class Qwen3_5DecoderLayer(Qwen3NextDecoderLayer):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        layer_type: str,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super(Qwen3NextDecoderLayer, self).__init__()
+
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+
+        self.layer_type = layer_type
+        self.layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        is_moe_layer = config.model_type == "qwen3_5_moe_text"
+        self.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe = (
+            parallel_config.use_sequence_parallel_moe
+            and parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
+            and is_moe_layer
+        )
+        # Defer row-parallel all-reduces to the following norm
+        # (deepseek_v32 pattern); exclude PP and SP.
+        self.use_fused_allreduce_norm = (
+            get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size() > 1
+            and parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
+            and not self.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe
+            and flashinfer_trtllm_fused_allreduce_norm is not None
+        )
+        # Whether this layer's MLP/MoE leaves an un-reduced partial, i.e.
+        # whether the *next* norm (or the final norm) must do the all-reduce.
+        self.mlp_output_is_partial = self.use_fused_allreduce_norm
+        reduce_results = not (
+            self.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe or self.use_fused_allreduce_norm
+        )
+
+        if self.layer_type == "linear_attention":
+            self.linear_attn = QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention(
+                config=config,
+                vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.linear_attn",
+                gqa_interleaved_layout=False,
+                reduce_results=reduce_results,
+            )
+            # Recover the inductor gated-norm fusion with a Triton kernel that
+            # also reads z strided from the packed qkvz projection.
+            self.linear_attn._fused_gdn_gated_rms_norm = fused_gdn_gated_rms_norm
+        elif self.layer_type == "full_attention":
+            self.self_attn = Qwen3NextAttention(
+                config,
+                model_config=model_config,
+                cache_config=cache_config,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+                reduce_results=reduce_results,
+                mrope_positions_factor=mrope_positions_factor(vllm_config),
+            )
+            self.self_attn.use_fused_output_gate = True
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid layer_type {self.layer_type}")
+
+        if config.model_type == "qwen3_5_moe_text":
+            self.mlp = Qwen3NextSparseMoeBlock(
+                vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                reduce_results=not self.use_fused_allreduce_norm,
+            )
+            if self.use_fused_allreduce_norm:
+                # reduce_results=False is only honored on the plain-TP late-AR
+                # path (skip_final_all_reduce); EP/all2all, SP, zero experts,
+                # and replicated shared experts all produce or add a complete
+                # output, which a downstream fused norm would all-reduce again.
+                # NOTE: moe_config is shared across layers; the condition is
+                # layer-uniform, so this reset is idempotent.
+                moe_config = self.mlp.experts.moe_config
+                moe_partial_ok = (
+                    moe_config.skip_final_all_reduce
+                    and moe_config.tp_size > 1
+                    and moe_config.ep_size == 1
+                    and moe_config.dp_size == 1
+                    and not self.mlp.replicate_shared_expert
+                )
+                if moe_config.skip_final_all_reduce and not moe_partial_ok:
+                    moe_config.skip_final_all_reduce = False
+                self.mlp_output_is_partial = moe_partial_ok
+        elif config.model_type == "qwen3_5_text":
+            self.mlp = Qwen3NextMLP(
+                hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size,
+                hidden_act=config.hidden_act,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                reduce_results=not self.use_fused_allreduce_norm,
+            )
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid model_type {config.model_type}")
+
+        self.input_layernorm = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+
+        self.layer_scale = getattr(config, "layer_scale", False)
+        if self.layer_scale:
+            self.attn_layer_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.zeros(
+                    1,
+                    1,
+                    config.hidden_size,
+                ),
+            )
+            self.ffn_layer_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.zeros(
+                    1,
+                    1,
+                    config.hidden_size,
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ):
+        if not self.use_fused_allreduce_norm:
+            return super().forward(hidden_states, residual, positions, **kwargs)
+
+        # layer_scale is a per-channel multiply, which commutes with the
+        # deferred all-reduce.
+        if residual is None:
+            residual = hidden_states
+            hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
+        elif self.mlp_output_is_partial:
+            hidden_states, residual = fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm(
+                hidden_states, residual, self.input_layernorm
+            )
+        else:
+            hidden_states, residual = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states, residual)
+
+        if self.layer_type == "linear_attention":
+            hidden_states = self.linear_attn(hidden_states=hidden_states)
+        elif self.layer_type == "full_attention":
+            hidden_states = self.self_attn(
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                positions=positions,
+            )
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("Invalid layer_type")
+
+        if self.layer_scale:
+            if len(hidden_states.shape) == 2:
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.attn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype)[0] + 1
+                )
+            else:
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.attn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype) + 1
+                )
+
+        hidden_states, residual = fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm(
+            hidden_states, residual, self.post_attention_layernorm
+        )
+        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
+
+        if self.layer_scale:
+            if len(hidden_states.shape) == 2:
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.ffn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype)[0] + 1
+                )
+            else:
+                assert len(hidden_states.shape) == len(self.ffn_layer_scale.shape), (
+                    f"shape must be the same {len(hidden_states.shape)}, "
+                    f"{len(self.ffn_layer_scale.shape)}"
+                )
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.ffn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype) + 1
+                )
+
+        return hidden_states, residual
+

+class Qwen3_5Model(nn.Module, EagleModelMixin):
+    # Qwen3.5 ships the GDN in_proj checkpoints separately (qwen3-next
+    # pre-fuses them); fuse them on top of the qwen3-next QKV/gate_up mapping.
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = Qwen3NextModel.hf_to_vllm_mapper | WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_stacked={
+            ".in_proj_qkv": (".in_proj_qkvz", (0, 1, 2)),
+            ".in_proj_z": (".in_proj_qkvz", 3),
+            ".in_proj_b": (".in_proj_ba", 0),
+            ".in_proj_a": (".in_proj_ba", 1),
+        }
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__()
+
+        config: Qwen3_5TextConfig | Qwen3_5MoeTextConfig = (
+            vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        )
+        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+
+        eplb_config = parallel_config.eplb_config
+        self.num_redundant_experts = eplb_config.num_redundant_experts
+
+        self.config = config
+        self.quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+
+        self.vocab_size = config.vocab_size
+
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            self.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+        )
+
+        def get_layer(prefix: str):
+            return Qwen3_5DecoderLayer(
+                vllm_config,
+                layer_type=config.layer_types[extract_layer_index(prefix)],
+                prefix=prefix,
+            )
+
+        self.start_layer, self.end_layer, self.layers = make_layers(
+            config.num_hidden_layers, get_layer, prefix=f"{prefix}.layers"
+        )
+        # Mirror of the decoder layers' flag (uniform across layers): when
+        # True, every layer returns its MLP/MoE output as an un-reduced TP
+        # partial, so the final norm and eagle aux captures must all-reduce.
+        self.mlp_output_is_partial = getattr(
+            self.layers[self.start_layer], "mlp_output_is_partial", False
+        )
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = make_empty_intermediate_tensors_factory(
+            ["hidden_states", "residual"], config.hidden_size
+        )
+
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            self.norm = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        else:
+            self.norm = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.aux_hidden_state_layers: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+    @property
+    def use_sequence_parallel(self) -> bool:
+        return self.layers[self.start_layer].use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe
+
+    def _maybe_add_hidden_state(
+        self,
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor],
+        layer_idx: int,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual is None and layer_idx in self.aux_hidden_state_layers:
+            # The layer-0 capture aliases the embeddings, which become the
+            # first residual and are mutated in place by the next layer's
+            # fused-add norm; capture by value.
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.clone()
+        if (
+            residual is not None
+            and self.mlp_output_is_partial
+            and layer_idx in self.aux_hidden_state_layers
+        ):
+            # hidden_states is an un-reduced TP partial; the aux capture needs
+            # the complete hidden state.
+            hidden_states = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(hidden_states)
+        return super()._maybe_add_hidden_state(
+            aux_hidden_states, layer_idx, hidden_states, residual
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | IntermediateTensors | tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor]]:
+        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank:
+            if inputs_embeds is not None:
+                hidden_states = inputs_embeds
+            else:
+                hidden_states = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+            residual = None
+        else:
+            assert intermediate_tensors is not None
+            hidden_states = intermediate_tensors["hidden_states"]
+            residual = intermediate_tensors["residual"]
+
+        full_num_tokens = positions.shape[-1]
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sequence_parallel_chunk(hidden_states)
+            assert residual is None
+
+        aux_hidden_states = self._maybe_add_hidden_state([], 0, hidden_states, residual)
+        for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(
+            islice(self.layers, self.start_layer, self.end_layer),
+            start=self.start_layer,
+        ):
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(
+                positions=positions,
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                residual=residual,
+            )
+            self._maybe_add_hidden_state(
+                aux_hidden_states, layer_idx + 1, hidden_states, residual
+            )
+
+        if not get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            return IntermediateTensors(
+                {"hidden_states": hidden_states, "residual": residual}
+            )
+        if self.mlp_output_is_partial:
+            # The last layer's MLP/MoE output is an un-reduced TP partial;
+            # fuse its all-reduce into the final norm.
+            hidden_states, _ = fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm(
+                hidden_states, residual, self.norm
+            )
+        else:
+            hidden_states, _ = self.norm(hidden_states, residual)
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            if aux_hidden_states:
+                hidden_size = hidden_states.shape[-1]
+                hidden_states = torch.cat([hidden_states, *aux_hidden_states], dim=-1)
+                hidden_states = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(hidden_states, 0)
+                hidden_states = hidden_states[:full_num_tokens]
+                hidden_states, *aux_hidden_states = hidden_states.split(
+                    hidden_size, dim=-1
+                )
+            else:
+                hidden_states = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(hidden_states, 0)
+                hidden_states = hidden_states[:full_num_tokens]
+        if aux_hidden_states:
+            return hidden_states, aux_hidden_states
+        return hidden_states
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        return loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)

+import torch
+
+from vllm.third_party.flash_linear_attention.ops.layernorm_guard import (
+    calc_rows_per_block,
+)
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["M"])
+def _fused_gdn_gated_rms_norm_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    z_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    stride_x_tok,
+    stride_z_tok,
+    stride_out_tok,
+    M,  # number of tokens
+    eps,
+    N: tl.constexpr,  # head_v_dim
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS_PER_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    NORM_BEFORE_GATE: tl.constexpr,
+    ACTIVATION: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """FLA-equivalent per-head gated RMS norm with token-strided z."""
+    row_start = tl.program_id(0) * ROWS_PER_BLOCK
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+
+    rows = row_start + tl.arange(0, ROWS_PER_BLOCK)
+    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    row_mask = rows[:, None] < M
+    col_mask = cols[None, :] < N
+    mask = row_mask & col_mask
+
+    x_ptrs = x_ptr + rows[:, None] * stride_x_tok + head * N + cols[None, :]
+    z_ptrs = z_ptr + rows[:, None] * stride_z_tok + head * N + cols[None, :]
+
+    x = tl.load(x_ptrs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+
+    if not NORM_BEFORE_GATE:
+        z = tl.load(z_ptrs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        if ACTIVATION == "swish" or ACTIVATION == "silu":
+            x *= z * tl.sigmoid(z)
+        elif ACTIVATION == "sigmoid":
+            x *= tl.sigmoid(z)
+
+    xbar = tl.where(mask, x, 0.0)
+    var = tl.sum(xbar * xbar, axis=1) / N
+    rstd = tl.rsqrt(var + eps)
+
+    w = tl.load(w_ptr + cols, mask=cols < N, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = x * rstd[:, None] * w[None, :]
+
+    if NORM_BEFORE_GATE:
+        z = tl.load(z_ptrs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        if ACTIVATION == "swish" or ACTIVATION == "silu":
+            y *= z * tl.sigmoid(z)
+        elif ACTIVATION == "sigmoid":
+            y *= tl.sigmoid(z)
+
+    out_ptrs = out_ptr + rows[:, None] * stride_out_tok + head * N + cols[None, :]
+    tl.store(out_ptrs, y.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
+def fused_gdn_gated_rms_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    z: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    num_v_heads: int,
+    head_v_dim: int,
+    norm_before_gate: bool,
+    activation: str,
+) -> None:
+    """Gated RMS norm ``out = rms_norm(x) * act(z)`` for Qwen3.5 GDN.
+
+    Args:
+        x: (num_tokens, num_v_heads * head_v_dim), contiguous. May alias out.
+        z: (num_tokens, num_v_heads * head_v_dim) gate values, typically a
+            strided view into the packed in_proj_qkvz output. Only the last
+            dim must be contiguous.
+        weight: (head_v_dim,) shared per-head norm weight.
+        out: (num_tokens, num_v_heads * head_v_dim), contiguous.
+        eps: RMS norm epsilon.
+        num_v_heads: number of V heads per TP rank.
+        head_v_dim: head_v_dim (per-row norm size).
+        norm_before_gate: if True, out = norm(x) * act(z), else
+            out = norm(x * act(z)).
+        activation: "swish"/"silu" or "sigmoid".
+
+    """
+    assert x.shape == z.shape == out.shape and x.dim() == 2
+    assert x.stride(-1) == 1 and z.stride(-1) == 1 and out.stride(-1) == 1
+    assert weight.shape == (head_v_dim,) and weight.stride(0) == 1
+    assert x.shape[1] == num_v_heads * head_v_dim
+
+    num_tokens = x.shape[0]
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return
+    block_n = triton.next_power_of_2(head_v_dim)
+    rows_per_block = calc_rows_per_block(num_tokens, x.device)
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(num_tokens, rows_per_block), num_v_heads)
+    _fused_gdn_gated_rms_norm_kernel[grid](
+        x,
+        z,
+        weight,
+        out,
+        x.stride(0),
+        z.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        num_tokens,
+        eps,
+        N=head_v_dim,
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        ROWS_PER_BLOCK=rows_per_block,
+        NORM_BEFORE_GATE=norm_before_gate,
+        ACTIVATION=activation,
+        num_warps=min(max(block_n // 256, 1), 8),
+    )
